name: EuroCham Singapore
summary: European Chamber umbrella for EU business advocacy, sector committees, and cross-national networking.
body: EuroCham aggregates European business interests — useful if your work spans multiple EU markets rather than a single national chamber. Committee work and sector briefings are where deeper relationships form; the open mixer calendar alone rarely justifies the fee. Compare against your national chamber (German, French, Nordic, etc.) and run a six-month introductions-vs-dues test. Pair with nationality associations when you need cultural belonging rather than BD cards.
membershipNotes: Company membership typical — verify SME options and current fees.
